adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` to an array and `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents()` now iterates over that array, creating events per destination/credential. However, non-Google calendar implementations still pick only the first destination calendar: Office365 `createEvent` destructures `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and uses `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId` to build the URL; Lark does the same for create/update/delete; and the CalDAV base (`packages/lib/CalendarService.ts`) filters calendars using only `mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId`. Since `handleNewBooking` builds the array with the organizer/eventType calendar first and then `push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` for COLLECTIVE, when creating a collective member’s event with their own credential these services will still target `destinationCalendar[0]` (the main host’s calendar), which can lead to wrong calendar selection/404s.
